service_text: A SERVICE CALL WAS MADE FOR NO HEAT.  UPON OUR INSPECTION WE FOUND THE HEAT EXCHANGER LEAKING.  WE REPLACED THE HEAT EXCHANGER UNDER WARRANTY TO CORRECT THIS ISSUE.
No heat  Cracked heat exchanger   Installed new heat exchanger

Arrived onsite to assess issues with heat. Shutdown the unit, valved the gas supply out and removed both burner manifolds. Cleaned up the bottom of the exchanger assembly and resealed the heating section with high temperature RTV. Reassembled the heating section. Restored equipment configuration. Recovered and weighed refrigerant from both circuits. Weighed in proper amount of 410a (22.5 ckt b, 15 ckt a). Found motor master configuration wrong and changed it. Aligned gas burners.
Apply labor to correct burner alignment
Installed missing limit switch # 1 on heating section.
Picked up materials for job. Cut metal patches on roof and secured to openings. Started up and checked for air leaks.
Checked in with customer and waited for fire drill. Then hauled tools and ladder to roof. Cut metal to cover holes in heating section. Then screwed covers in. Checked for air leaks.

Arrived onsite to make repairs to the gas heat. Upon arrival, shut the unit down, valved out the gas and disassembled the burners. Cleaned up real well and resealed the firebox. Clean up blower section, reseal the fire box an align burners. Check configuration settings and change as necessary. Check operation of dehumidification, cooling and heating.

Arrived onsite to make repairs to the gas heat. Upon arrival, shut the unit down, valved out the gas and disassembled the burners. Cleaned up blower section, resealed fire box and aligned the burner. Check configuration settings. Changed as necessary. Check operation of dehumidification, heating and cooling.

Arrived onsite to assess issues with heat. Shutdown the unit, valved the gas supply out and removed both burner manifolds. Cleaned up the bottom of the exchanger assembly and resealed the heating section with high temperature RTV. Reassembled the heating section. Aligned all the gas burners.. Check configuration settings and change as necessary. Check operation of dehumidification, cooling and heating.

Not heating properly.  Ignition board for stage 1 and 2 heat had failed. Changed so that stage 1 and 2 can work, but needed to replace ignition board so stage 3 and 4 can operate.  Replaced ignition board.
No heat  Found ignition board with a internal fault code  Replaced board

RTU #28 repairs. Checked in with customer and went to unit. Powered unit off and changed out the ignition board on the lower burner. Powered unit back up and put into test mode. Test ran burner in low and high. Burner is operating correctly now. Cleaned up work area and released unit to customer.
Bad IGC board will not fire - stays on 1 or 2.
Replacement fuses needed for repairs.  MT from 014T79893
found cracks in fan blades, pieces of fan blade missing; repaired and replaced with the same
unit not working properly, fan balde not put on right from factory, when started unit up fan balde loose and bend prop
Found return air damper shaft out of normal position . Adjusted shaft and performed test. All damper operation is now okay.

Pick up new blade and replace defective one start up and check operation. Check out unit and find system start up on humidity sensor and run by it self programmed unit only to operate on thermostat command.
UPON START UP, THE BLADE CRACKED & BROKE FROM VIBRATION. DOA.  REPLACED
The condenser fan failed - it was out of balance and the cap flew off during operation
The plastic was warped - CAD replaced

Travel  Discovered RTU-6 noisy supply fan was being caused by supply fan motor bearing issues. Fan is on order. Job Not Complete   10/18/19 THestla  Assisted with motor replacement  Arrived to replace failed supply fan motor for RTU-6. Removed failed motor and rigged down off the roof. Rigged new motor on the roof and in place. Discovered motor had severe damage at the mounting feet while trying to install the motor. This was either...   10/28/19 Thestla  Went to office to pick up parts, found that new motor was damaged in shipping . Went to supply house to pick a new motor up locally.  10/29/19  TVL  10/29/19 THESTLA  Assisted with blower motor install.  Travel   Replaced failed supply fan motor for RTU-6. Tested and adjusted abb drive parameters as needed. Job Complete
Leaking Condenser Coil. Removed old leaking coil, recover refrigerant, replaced coil.

Arrived at job site and checked in with customer. Compressor A1 not coming on. Found middle bridge on contactor is upside down.need to replace contactor. Found wire loose on high limit switch mounted on blower housing. Reconnected wire.  Arrived at job site and checked in with customer. Replaced contactor A1.on rtu2.checked compressor operation. Checked heating.
Lockout tag out unit. Realign Power exhaust fan wheel.tested operation of exhaust fans. Fan wheel no longer grinding on fan housing.

While completing factory start up condenser fan #4 grounded and tripped main breaker. Unplugged fan to verify motor windings were grounded. Need to replace motor. Ordered new parts.  Changed condenser motor. Checked unit for proper operation.
Condenser fan motor failed bearings. these bearings are bad. Motor will not turn.
Changed out defective motor and rewire, run and test, operates properly
Blower motor was making a lot of noise.  Tech found the bearings were defective.  Tech ordered new motor and installed.
FAN MOTOR NOT OPERATING - VOLTAGE PRESENT ON TERMINAL 460 VOLT - REPLACED MOTOR

Disconnected wires off contactor ohm our wires . One set was open , hooked the other one back up & tested the other 3 fans all ok. Bagged off condenser fan that was bad & let system run . Ordered fan motor. Picked the up motor. Replaced motor, had no contact info. Found contactor has a bad contact. Went to supply house and picked up new contactor. Replaced contactor, checked operation, ok.
FOUND MOTOR WOULD NOT START  REPLACED MOTOR
fOUND OUT MOTOR WAS GROUNDED - REPLACED
unit not cooling found the motor would not start repl it working now
Remote Update: 1.completed service bulletin for supply fan motor grounding issue.  installed motor ground  wire  on fan motor.
Rear Motor Plate bearing seal is laying in the bottom of the rear plate.  Seal was not installed correctly at the motor manufacturing facility.  Remove and replace the motor.
MOTOR SEIZED AS WELL AS THE CONTACTOR.  REPLACED PARTS LOOKING GOOD !
Replaced defective motor upon inspection of unit.

Engineer recommended pulling all plugs from mbb board and putting one plug back on at a time. Unit started up fine with no comm failures. Monitored unit to ensure it was fixed. Cycled power numerous times and no comm failure alarm. Explained issue to customer.
NOISY BEARINGS AND OVERLOADS DRIVE.  MOTOR REPLACED
found motor to be grounded.replaced motor
The system was not cooling properly. Found bad condenser fan motor and replaced.
Condenser fan motor A was noisy then stoped working. Motor bearings sound like a bearing is loose. Shut unit down until repaired. Need to check relief fan 3, won???t run.

Arrived onsite and checked in with the customer. Went to rooftop of building and found rooftop in alarm. The alarm was for a VFD Fault. Went to the VFD and checked the parameters for the current setting and found the keypads Swapped. The unit has power exhaust on the unit. Swapped the keypads back to its original drive and restarted rooftop. Monitored rooftop to make sure alarm did not return.
indoor fan motor very noisy - found motor bearings failing - removed motor and replaced with new motor. Start up and test operations - okay.

Investigate Issues on RTU 3  Checked rtu 3. Checked heating control circuit. Couldn???t find a shirt on 24 volt side. Moved wires around & control breaker number 5 never tripped. Also will have to check economizer on a warmer day. It strikes to 100% for some reason.
NO COOLING  MOTOR FAILED  REPLCED MOTOR
No heat calls on 6/7. Units were both running in heat when I arrived. I ran both in test mode and they both ran fine. Units are online at this time.

Checked in with customer. 3 units not running out on roll out switch. Reset and checked flame, gas pressure and operation. Gas pressure on the low side tried to adjust but could not get anything more out of regulator. Adjusted back to where I found it. Possible wind blowing back against draft vents and causing roll out or low gas pressure to building causing issues. Everything running at this time.
